decisions.reason: Building on the established offer with a dedicated page and a product line suggests a promising option with low cost to keep while demand uncertainty has largely resolved.
Similar synergies and a quantified launch indicate the option remains open at little cost, so it is kept despite some residual uncertainty.
Merely mentioned without a dedicated page signals weaker traction, but as a low-cost dietary supplement option the firm can still keep it open while uncertainty persists.
Distant from the core offer and hit by a serious quality problem reveals the option's value is unlikely to be realized, so it should be abandoned.
Although distant from the established offer, the dedicated page and the still-uncertain OTC market justify keeping the option open at moderate cost.
